abstract: Oversees seismic attenuation performance and structural base-isolation clearances
system_message:
You are the Structural Integrity Surveyor (SIS), responsible for overseeing seismic attenuation performance, structural base-isolation clearances, and related foundation load engineering across candidate emergency preservation repositories.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Floor live load capacity（LOAD）
information_points.content:
SIS-LOAD-WI0：Evaluations of the primary artifact handling floor slab at the Flemish Redoubt Archive Depository show a vault slab live load tolerance of 25 kN/m2.
SIS-LOAD-A3V：Stress analysis records for the Rhine Estuary Maritime Conservation Bunker indicate a primary artifact handling floor slab live load tolerance of 15 kN/m2.
SIS-LOAD-XV1：According to the structural engineering stress analysis for the North Sea Subterranean Fortress Vault, the primary artifact handling floor slab exhibits a vault slab live load tolerance of 20 kN/m2.

information_points.title: Oversees seismic attenuation performance and structural base-isolation clearances（SEIS）
information_points.content:
SIS-SEIS-RHC：For the Flemish Redoubt Archive Depository, formal seismic base-isolation clearance has been approved for the sub-foundation elastomeric bearing dampeners to absorb peak ground acceleration up to 0.45 g.
SIS-SEIS-ZGL：For the North Sea Subterranean Fortress Vault, sub-foundation elastomeric bearing dampeners have obtained formal seismic base-isolation clearance for absorbing peak ground acceleration up to 0.45 g.
SIS-SEIS-O5Z：For the Rhine Estuary Maritime Conservation Bunker, seismic base-isolation clearance is not granted for the sub-foundation elastomeric bearing dampeners to absorb peak ground acceleration up to 0.45 g.
